body.x: Muller introduced a remote controllable smart electric heater at ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. on Sunday, Jan. 7th.

Muller collaborated with Netatmo, a house heating company, and developed a technology that connects an air conditioner with a radiator valve so that an electric radiator can be controlled by an Internet connection. A user can change the temperature or determine the exact range of use through an application. It is available on iOS and Android.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
